review.market_summary: 1) Rate repricing is the main story. October payrolls came in at +165k, above every forecast, and unemployment fell to 4.1%. Traders are now betting on a Fed rate hike, and Treasury yields rose on the day. This is the only strong signal today; every other axis scores close to zero. 2) The Democratic midterm sweep changes the policy outlook: a rewrite of tariff policy, an SEC-led rewrite of the CLARITY crypto bill, and scrutiny of Nvidia's chip exports. These play out over months, not days. 3) Tech is being sold hard (NVDA -9%, ARKK -7% this week, 'trillions wiped' from AI stocks) while gold and defensives are bid on U.S.-Iran tension. OPEC output nearing pre-war levels limits how high oil can go. Overall, the clean trade is higher rates. Growth and stock trades are muddied by hawkish rates and the tech unwind.
